Bettina asked for a Monday 08:00 "Coastal week ahead" digest, and I have not set that up. I posted three replies in her #coastal-team thread, and the first one was wrong: it said I had no scheduler, but I never checked. The second corrected that, and the third states the actual position.

I did not create a scheduled job. I couldn't verify that one could post into #coastal-team, so I left it alone. I can write the digest by hand from #coastal-team and #coastal-random whenever Bettina asks, and leave out finance figures unless they are already posted in that channel.

Someone with admin access would need to confirm a Slack delivery target for a recurring job. I did not run the gbrain search or read either channel, since nothing needed reading for this reply.
